name: EduTec Grading System
description: The EduTec Grading System is a centralized platform for assessing academic submissions such as BA/MA theses and seminar reports. It offers structured, report-specific rubrics. By standardizing evaluation criteria, the system reduces educator workload while minimizing assessment errors and ensuring fair, consistent grading.

name: EduTec Grading System - GenAI
description: In this version, the EduTec Grading System uses GenAI not for assessment, but to support educators in creating clearer, higher-quality rubrics.

name: EchoMeet - SD VPN needed
description: EchoMeet is an AI-powered meeting transcription and summarization app that turns recorded meetings into clear, actionable insights. By uploading an audio file (e.g., MP3), users can generate accurate transcripts, analyze the content with their chosen LLM model, and produce concise summaries. Results can be easily exported and downloaded as a PDF for sharing or documentation.

name: AI ToolLab
description: Goethe University's AI ToolLab is the central access point for a broad range of AI tools. It provides teachers and, in the future, all students and staff, with secure, experimental access to new AI technologies. Together with the AI Community of Practice, these tools are tested, reflected on, and refined before being rolled out as integrated services across the university.

name: EduTec Drive (Temporary)
description: This Drive folder brings together a variety of resources shared exclusively with EduTec members, such as PhD information, literature reviews, presentations, papers, tools, and more..

name: Thesis Topics - EduTec
description: Here, you can add, remove, or update the thesis topics you wish to supervise and publish on the Edutec website.

name: BA / MA thesis registration
description:
1. Enroll in the Moodle course “Prüfungsamt Informatik” (Examination Office Computer Science):

https://moodle.studiumdigitale.uni-frankfurt.de/moodle/course/view.php?id=7153

2. There, please click on “Anmeldung Abschlussarbeiten” (Registration of Final Theses) and enter the details of your thesis:

https://moodle.studiumdigitale.uni-frankfurt.de/moodle/course/section.php?id=102618

Providing the name of the second examiner significantly speeds up the evaluation process. Therefore, it is best to clarify beforehand who could serve as the second examiner and also enter this information in Moodle.

3. You will receive a confirmation email within 24 hours. The first examiner (supervisor) must reply to this email for the topic to be officially registered.
